inputs.original_text: Phoenix city leaders are taking new steps to keep an eye on federal immigration enforcement. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that puts new restrictions on ICE and other law enforcement agencies using city property. FOX 10's Danielle Miller reports.
inputs.modified_text: Phoenix leaders are calling Wednesday night’s vote “oversight,” but it sounds like cover for controlling where federal immigration enforcement can operate and what the public is allowed to see. The restrictions put the power in city officials’ hands to set the rules and manage the story. The accountability pitch is part of the maneuver, not a reason to take their explanation at face value.
